rationale: An integral restricted to E cannot control the tail outside E; homogeneity and uniform integrability require the whole-space integral.
The conclusion likewise needs the whole-space integral from Definition 246Ab.
Applying 246F to u chi(X minus E) and the preceding epsilon bound gives 2 epsilon; delta has no such role.
Uniform integrability of the singleton {v} supplies a whole-space integral; restricting to E leaves the tail uncontrolled.
Both displayed integrals must be whole-space integrals to prove Definition 246Ab.
The nu_n are signed functionals. A positive common control measure must use total variations; the signed sum can cancel and need not be a measure.
